description: This file defines the class 'gforgesoapInterface' which extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and provides methods for connecting to a GForge issue tracking system via SOAP, managing issues, statuses, and configuration for integration purposes.

classes.name: gforgesoapInterface
classes.description: This class provides an interface to the GForge issue tracker via SOAP, including methods to connect, retrieve issues, check status, and handle configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets configuration and connects to the GForge system.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration with default URLs if not provided.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code for a given issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose (HTML formatted) status for a given issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueSummary
methods.description: Returns the summary of an issue identified by issue ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves full issue details from the issue tracker system.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if an issue ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Verifies if an issue exists in the tracker.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a SOAP connection to the GForge system.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to the tracker system is active.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a SOAP client object for communication.

methods.name: helperParseDate
methods.description: Parses and formats date strings from the tracker.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuration XML.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Builds an HTML formatted string based on status code.

methods.name: buildSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Builds an HTML formatted summary, including due date.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks that the environment has the necessary SOAP extension enabled.
